haste.oewn-00556685-n.example: Well, Jane, make haste and tell us; make haste, my love.
haste.oewn-00556685-n.reasoning: The reader is right that this example does not belong to the gloss it prints under. The imperative 'make haste' is an exhortation to be quick and carries no carelessness at all - nothing is dropped, forgotten or knocked over, and no fault attaches to the person hurrying - so it cannot illustrate 'moving hurriedly and in a careless manner'. The two remaining examples both show the speed costing something (a forgotten book, a knocked cup), which is exactly the axis. The note is untouched: it describes the word's weight under this gloss correctly and was not what was faulted.

ultra.oewn-01539365-s.tone: Not just distance but too much distance - it drives an opinion or action past the limit its own position would have kept to, where *far* marks the same remove and leaves the verdict open.
ultra.oewn-01539365-s.reasoning: The old note claimed the word 'says nothing about it beyond how far out it sits', which is the verdict-free description that earns *far* and *extreme* their neutral charges, while sitting on a negative charge - note and charge could not both be true. I resolved it in favour of the charge rather than the note: under this gloss the word does not merely locate a position, it presents the position as having gone past a limit that ought to have held, which is why it works as a label applied to a stance rather than a measurement of it. The new note asserts that excess, keeps the positional observation the old note was built on, and now names *far* as the member that does only the locating.

scheme.oewn-05913942-n.tone: The intricacy is what it adds - a plan worked out in enough system and detail that the design itself draws notice, where *system* names only the method for getting there.
scheme.oewn-05913942-n.reasoning: The gloss is neutral and both examples are approving, so -1 was wrong. The note had asserted the charge it got wrong - 'also the catch' promised a disparagement it never delivered and could not deliver from this gloss - so the note had to move with the charge rather than the charge alone. What is kept is the whole substance of the old note: that conspicuous elaborateness is this word's distinguishing feature, and that *system* names bare method by contrast. What is dropped is only the unearned suspicion in 'the catch'.

dame.oewn-10008828-n.tone: Stately and formal - it names her refinement as a standing she holds and is addressed by, where *ma'am* and *madam* pay the courtesy in passing.
dame.oewn-10008828-n.reasoning: The old note described the offhand slang word for a woman, not the sense glossed here; 'blunt and breezy' and 'withholds the deference' belong to a different entry. Rewritten onto the printed gloss, where the word is ceremonious and treats refinement as rank rather than manner. The charge moves with it because the 0 was set by the clause I removed - 'withholds the deference' is precisely what made it neutral among four positively charged siblings - so leaving it would have left the sense asserting a reserve the new note denies. Held at 1 rather than 2 so it does not displace *gentlewoman*, which takes refinement as her entire standing; *dame* attaches it to the name.
